actions: Decide how to resolve bug 3.14 criterion 2: either (a) approve correcting epic-input Done when 5 and Odbiór na UM760 point 2 so calibration is only required to log remote buttons that arrive as HID Consumer reports (Home, Back, voice assistant), or (b) approve a new story for a hook-free calibration mode that registers keyboard Raw Input (architecture AD-8 allows this only without an LL hook in the same process).

Resolve the Source conflict for the Keyboard button with bmad-architecture (HID usage 0x00CF as an additional trigger next to VK); it is the same decision that blocks Done when 5.
